Delivery Service

Delivery Service
We can deliver your IKEA purchases to your home or workplace. We can deliver to your front door, or we can take your delivery items all the way into your room of choice.

Delivery excludes plants, food, and fragile objects and articles from AS-IS. For AS-IS deliveries, please speak to a member of staff in our AS-IS section.
Slabs for delivery prices
